preconditions.description: Number of vertices and queries are within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= ai <= n for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Values on vertices are within specified bounds.
Number of edges is exactly n-1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Edge vertices are within valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in queries)
preconditions.description: Query vertices are within valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(u == v or u in ancestors[v] for u, v in queries)
preconditions.description: Vertex u is an ancestor of vertex v in each query.

postconditions.description: Number of output lines matches the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(answer, int) for answer in output)
postconditions.description: Each output line is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= answer <= n for answer in output)
postconditions.description: Each output value is within valid range.

postconditions.expression: all(max_xor(u, v) == answer for (u, v), answer in zip(queries, output))
postconditions.description: Each output value is the maximal XOR value along the path from u to v.
